incarnationDecision.reason: The roster loadout names Doomblade, Flame Belch and Super Shotgun Meathook, matching Eternal2020. This wave selects Eternal2020; the previous 2016 plan is not blended into the design.

limitations: Official Steam-distributed DOOM Eternal key art; visible armor, exposed upper arms and left-forearm blade. Stylized lighting obscures minor hardware; not a 360-degree model sheet.
Same official key artwork in horizontal crop; not a second independent design. Body proportions and blade are readable, lower legs partly obscured.
Official Steam screenshot, close helmet detail; armor outside the crop is not verified by this image.
Frame from official Launch Trailer sampled with fps=1/4, around38seconds;480p sideview shows exposed biceps and shoulder launcher, not a360-degree review.

Frame near 7 seconds from official Launch Trailer; two parallel barrels, engraved break-action receiver, dark stock and underside twin-point Meathook are visible; camera crops part of stock and low resolution limits tiny engravings.
Frame from official Launch Trailer sampled with fps=1/4, around10seconds; open breech and two barrel chambers visible; not full Meathook geometry.

DOOM+DOOMII official Steam cover containing DOOM1993 illustrated classic marine. Used for CG13 costume only: grey helmet, green chest/shoulders, bare upper arms and torn abdominal gap; low-resolution combined cover limits exact trouser/boot details.
Official1080p frame of the left side: exposed biceps, armor profiles and shoulder launcher visible; far-side surfaces are hidden.
Official1080p final promotional model stance with both legs/boots visible. Strong orange lighting alters color and lower boots partly overlap foreground demon shapes; not a neutral360-degree sheet.
Official1080p weapon close-up, metal engraving and underside Meathook clear. Stock and muzzle extend out of the frame; this complements the480p side/reload views.
Orange visor and loosely drawn firearm are not sufficient canonical evidence. Sprite is preserved, not copied as the sole identity source.

visualLocks.incarnation: Eternal2020 base armor, no 2016 closed upper-arm suit or Dark Ages fur cloak
visualLocks.helmet: Olive closed shell, vented brow, broad dark green visor, silver-grey respirator/jaw and angular cheek vents; no invented exposed face
visualLocks.silhouette: Muscular adult-shaped human silhouette, two arms/two legs; age not separately certified, family-only scenes
visualLocks.armor: Olive chest and rounded shoulder plates, bronze/grey abdominal segments, brown utility belt, green armored legs and boots
visualLocks.exposedMembers: Natural exposed biceps on both upper arms between shoulder plates and armored gauntlets
visualLocks.leftForearm: Exactly one Doomblade on anatomical LEFT forearm: viewer RIGHT in frontal composition
visualLocks.leftShoulder: Exactly one Flame Belch launcher mounted behind/above anatomical LEFT shoulder: viewer RIGHT frontally
visualLocks.signatureWeapon: Super Shotgun with exactly two parallel barrels, engraved break-action metal receiver, dark brown stock and separate twin-point underside Meathook; no pump/assault rifle

scopeLimitations: Official promotional art and selected official trailer frames are real independent references inspected locally; they do not certify every hidden model surface or every tiny pixel detail.
All scenes and poses are newly invented fan art, not claims of official in-game scenes. CG09–15 are explicitly What If.
CG13 only swaps into the classic DOOM1993 marine costume; classic image does not replace the Eternal identity references elsewhere.
External pages DoomWiki, DoomFandom, SlayersClub and BethesdaGear were unavailable; no claim is made that those pages or images were inspected.

The1080p official trailer was additionally consulted after initial CG generation, to improve the independent model/equipment review and support the requested runtime sprite correction. It is not a generated reference.
